summary: Seed analysis is partial. Item identities, guaranteed floor spawns, route-independent quest reward contracts, and shop stock are reported on every floor. Ordinary floor loot is exact on the first floor; later ordinary loot and exact floor layouts are published only while generation remains provably free of player-state influence. Boss-floor layouts are also exact. Concrete quest details are hidden when earlier run choices can change them.

implemented: Potion colours, scroll runes, and ring gems for the whole run
areas.impact: Identities are settled by the seed before the run begins. No known divergence from the game.

implemented: Guaranteed floor spawns on every floor — food, the Halls torches, Potions of Strength, Scrolls of Upgrade, Arcane Styli, Stones of Enchantment and Intuition, and the Trinket Catalyst with its four offers — with exact stack quantities, and searchable. Alchemy pots are shown as guaranteed floor appearances, including the first generated pot used for trinket timing. The Catalyst floor, earliest effective trinket floor, and first-deck transmutation order are also reported. Forbidden Runes removes every second guaranteed Scroll of Upgrade when selected

Route-independent reward contracts for the Sad Ghost, Old Wandmaker, Troll Blacksmith, and Ambitious Imp — option counts and categories, tier and upgrade ranges, curse status, conditional enchantments or glyphs, and the choices required to claim them
Shop stock and quantities on every shop floor, common items named exactly and deck-driven slots given as a category and tier; the depth-20 Imp shop carries its quest-completion condition
Ordinary floor loot from heaps, chests, locked chests, and skeletons, with class, stack quantity, upgrade level, and curse
Seed search matches item class, a minimum upgrade level, and a floor range
remaining: Ordinary floor loot is exact on the first floor. Later ordinary loot is published only while the floor also has an exact layout, so most later floors list guaranteed spawns, quest rewards, and shop stock only
Loot drawn after an artifact assumes no artifact was obtained outside level generation earlier in the run

Which of the four Trinket Catalyst offers a player takes, when it is upgraded, and when a Scroll of Transmutation is used are player choices. The analyzer applies the chronological held-trinket history you enter and never allows its upgrade level to decrease

The Sad Ghost's concrete spawn depth, tiers, levels, and option identities can change with player state before the Ghost appears. The analyzer can recalculate the no-Tooth and held Mimic Tooth +0 to +3 cases from the chosen floor, with or without Forbidden Runes; other trinkets and earlier artifact history are not yet enumerated

The Old Wandmaker's concrete spawn floor, quest type, wand classes, and wand levels can change with earlier run choices. Reports keep only the route-independent contract: two distinct uncursed +1 to +3 wand options, with at most one claimable

The Troll Blacksmith's concrete spawn floor, quest type, Smith classes, shared level, and effect identities can change if Mossy Clump shifts generation. Reports keep four mutually exclusive tier 3 to 5, +0 to +3, uncursed options; Parchment Scrap +1 held before the floor guarantees the paired effects. Reset-floor routes are not enumerated

The Ambitious Imp's concrete spawn floor, target, ring class, and upgrade level can change with earlier run choices. Reports keep one conditional cursed +2 to +4 ring; any ring class remains possible, and both the reward and depth-20 shop require quest completion
areas.impact: Reports understate ordinary loot and intentionally hide concrete quest options where player state can change them.

implemented: Room layouts, connections, doors, and stair placement on every regular floor, plus the boss floors of all five regions and the final floor
Room counts and room-type selection for every region, including special and secret rooms
Floor-by-floor verification against the real game for a set of reference seeds
remaining: An exact layout and room list is published only for the first floor and the boss floors; once a floor paints a room whose generation can react to player state, every later floor is shown as a baseline continuation instead
Mining and vault side-levels are not generated, so the Troll Blacksmith's mine has no floor of its own
Verification is per-seed; an unusual generation path can still diverge
areas.impact: Past the first floor, room selection, sizes, and connections are a plausible continuation rather than a guarantee, and the room list is withheld.

implemented: Layout, terrain, and prize generation for every special and secret room type in the pinned game, plus the Old Wandmaker's Mass Grave, Ritual Site, and Rot Garden quest rooms
Reward contracts for those rooms: how many drop, their categories, tier and upgrade bounds, and whether they are cursed
remaining: Reward contracts are published only on floors with an exact layout, so most floors list none
A room's exact reward identity usually depends on item-deck history and is reported as a constraint rather than a named item
In-room terrain and prize positions are confirmed only where a reference floor covers that room type
areas.impact: On floors without an exact layout, the special and secret rooms present are not reported at all.

implemented: Floor maps show room shapes, walls, doors, stairs, water, grass, traps, and plants as painted during generation
Maps are drawn for run settings you choose: whether Forbidden Runes is active and the floor-by-floor history of supported held-trinket upgrades and transmutations
Decorative overlays for the ritual site, blacksmith, imp, weak floor, demon spawner, City boss, Halls boss, and final floor
remaining: Cell-for-cell terrain is confirmed against the game on the first floor, Sewers floor 4, and Caves floors 11–14; other floors are checked at room, door, and generation-boundary level
Maps for floors without an exact layout are drawn as assumed continuations and can differ from your run
The Sewers, Prison, and Caves boss floors draw plain terrain without the game's decorative tile variants
Mass Grave and other uncovered room overlays remain plain
Quest side-levels, such as the Troll Blacksmith's mine, are not rendered
areas.impact: Previews show the deterministic floor layout — terrain, traps, plants, and water — captured before anything is placed in the level. They make no claims about NPCs, monsters, or where items end up.

outOfScope.title: Out of scope by design
outOfScope.note: These inputs and behaviours are not predictions and should not be read as analyzer errors.
items: Player decisions and inventory changes are not inferred
Item identities that depend on what a run already found are reported as constraints, never guessed
Shop details that depend on bags, artifact history, or inventory are excluded
Exact placement cells are excluded; the claim is that a spawn is guaranteed, not where it lands
Mimic and golden Mimic contents are excluded because their generation and carried rewards shift with run history
Combat drops and anything else rolled during play are excluded
Maps show layout only — no monsters, items, or loot
The starting Guidebook page is not seed-determined and is excluded
